about: Own-words reads from the daily research task (ADMIS, Rabobank, Czapp and the news feed). fund_score: -1 bearish to +1 bullish, a judgement on the fundamental news only.

cotton.fundamental: Dec has pushed back above the broken 77.05 level to ~77.6 (+0.62) with Mar ~81.65, helped by a slightly softer dollar (DXY ~103.4). It is a short-covering bounce rather than new supply news; into Dec first notice, high-grade certs remain a risk for old-crop longs, so 79.90 resistance is the level to prove the low is in.
events: Dec cotton ~77.62 (+0.62), range 76.82-77.70; Mar ~81.65 (ICE via TradingView)
Dollar index eases to ~103.4 (ICE via TradingView)

sugar.fundamental: Mar recovered from the early dip to 17.97 and trades ~18.21, back above 18.02 support and the 100-day near 18.13; the real's slide still keeps Centre-South mills hedging, so Brazil-side selling caps rallies near 18.35. Crude giving back part of its gain trims the ethanol offset.
events: Weak Brazilian real keeps Centre-South hedge pressure on (Bloomberg)
Crude pares gains as glut worries meet Gulf tanker attacks (Reuters)

coffee.fundamental: ICE-certified arabica stocks have fallen to their lowest since 1999, and nearby is responding: Dec ~286.1 (+5.4, high 288.3) is back above the 283.50 level and the 200-day, with Mar ~281.25 so the Dec/Mar inverse holds near 5 cents. That is a deliverability squeeze for Dec; Brazil's weaker real is the main brake on Mar and beyond.
events: ICE arabica certified stocks hit a 1999 low (ADMIS)
Dec arabica ~286.1 (+5.4), back above 283.50/200-day; Mar ~281.25 (ICE via TradingView)
Weaker Brazilian real encourages grower selling (Bloomberg)

cocoa.fundamental: Mar is flat-to-firmer near 5,196 (+12), holding above 5,160 support; nothing new on supply since the morning. Steady Ivory Coast arrivals and rising ICE-certified stocks keep the ample-supply picture, with dry West African weather the only open question for the mid-crop.
events: Rising ICE cocoa inventories keep pressure on (Barchart)
Dry West African weather keeps mid-crop questions open (ADMIS)
